policies.B1: A candidate fulfills technical credential criteria by having a minimum software engineering experience of 5 years along with an active CISSP credential.
policies.B2: A job applicant attains senior developer standing when meeting technical credential criteria together with a technical architecture assessment score of at least 80 points.
policies.D1: Placement on a lead software track is recommended for an applicant attaining senior developer standing who also completes a minimum compliance training time of 25 hours.
policies.B3: Candidate status for project leadership requires at least 5 years of software engineering experience, a minimum ethics exam score of 85 points, and a valid PMP credential.
policies.B4: Operational readiness for team manager duties is confirmed when an applicant satisfies candidate status for project leadership.
policies.D2: Appointment to a team leader post is approved for a candidate with operational readiness for team manager duties who finishes at least 3 management workshops.
policies.B5: Readiness for agile administration is granted if a staff candidate possesses a valid PMP credential, at least 4 years of software engineering experience, and a minimum peer endorsement count of 3.
policies.B6: Higher level team guidance qualification is reached when an applicant demonstrates readiness for agile administration and secures appointment to a team leader post.
policies.B7: An employee matches executive candidate requirements either by earning an executive leadership certificate or by participating in at least 10 executive mentoring sessions.
policies.B8: Qualification for department director roles requires matching executive candidate requirements alongside placement on a lead software track.
policies.D3: Enrollment in executive fast-track development is authorized for any staff member qualifying for department director roles.
policies.B9: Cloud architecture clearance is granted to an applicant holding an AWS Certified Solutions Architect credential.
policies.B10: Supervisory standing in client success is designated for a team member who executes a minimum of 10 client onboarding audits per quarter.
policies.B11: Directorial clearance in enterprise security is awarded to a staff member with a Certified Information Security Manager certification.
policies.B12: Designation as a chief commercial strategist requires maintaining a monthly sales conversion rate of at least 60 percent.
